امتنعن (form VIII)
# اِمْتَنَعْنَ (imtanaʕna) /im.ta.naʕ.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِمْتَنَعَ (imtanaʕa)
# اُمْتُنِعْنَ (umtuniʕna) /um.tu.niʕ.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِمْتَنَعَ (imtanaʕa)
# اِمْتَنِعْنَ (imtaniʕna) /im.ta.niʕ.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِمْتَنَعَ (imtanaʕa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
